_comment: Small detail parts for the Vanguard cockpit centre console (Docs/AssetPipeline_Modular.md: a complex composition is split into parts, each simple enough for an image-to-3D tool). The same four parts exist procedurally in ArtSource/Ships/Vanguard/Kitbash/CentreConsole.blend, so the two routes can be compared side by side. size_cm is what the part must be in the cockpit; every generator returns a normalised size, so the importer rescales to it.
style: Ironclad Vanguard: worn grey-blue painted steel, chamfered hard-surface edges, visible fasteners, no decals, no text, lit neutrally

parts.name: SwitchPanel
parts.prompt: small spacecraft cockpit switch panel: a rectangular metal plate with four toggle switches in a recessed row and a blank label strip below, worn grey-blue painted steel, chamfered edges, hard surface game asset, no text

parts.name: VentGrille
parts.prompt: small spacecraft cockpit vent grille: a rectangular metal frame with seven slanted louvres and a screw in two corners, worn grey-blue painted steel, hard surface game asset, no text

parts.name: CableBundle
parts.prompt: bundle of five thick spacecraft cables sagging between two square metal clamps, rubber insulation, worn metal clamps, hard surface game asset, no text

parts.name: DisplayFrame
parts.prompt: small spacecraft cockpit display bezel: a rectangular metal frame around a recessed flat screen, a short sun hood along the top edge and a screw in each corner, worn grey-blue painted steel, hard surface game asset, no text
